china_footprint.ssc_location: Suzhou (Suzhou Industrial Park) — J&J Global Services delivery center; one of 5 worldwide (alongside Tampa US, Manila PH, Bogota CO, Prague CZ)
china_footprint.notes: J&J Global Finance Services Asia Pacific (Suzhou) Center has ~170 finance staff delivering AR/AP/General Accounting for China mainland, HK/Taiwan, Japan, Korea. The Suzhou GBS center covers three functions: Finance, Human Resources, and Procurement. Suzhou Industrial Park is J&J Medical's largest integrated campus in China (manufacturing + SSC + R&D + regional procurement). ~16 legal entities in China; entered China 1985 via Xian Janssen JV.

tech_stack.concur_details: Johnson & Johnson selected SAP Concur Expense for expense management in 2016, displacing a legacy system and integrating with existing finance systems (per appsruntheworld customers database). As a global SAP shop with a Suzhou finance SSC, Concur is highly likely deployed across China operations, though China-specific confirmation is indirect. The China business is therefore an existing SAP Concur footprint — relevant for upsell/migration/optimization rather than greenfield Concur sale.

business_events.title: J&J MedTech moves to decentralized, business-unit-led operating model
business_events.summary: Effective January 2026, J&J MedTech restructured into a more decentralized BU-led model to cut bureaucracy and increase accountability — a structural change that often triggers finance-systems and process re-platforming.

business_events.title: Localized production of HARMONIC 7s ultrasonic scalpel in Suzhou; high-end medical device project
business_events.summary: J&J MedTech launched first domestic production of 7mm ultrasonic scalpels at J&J (Suzhou) Medical Devices in Suzhou Industrial Park, building on a recent high-end medical device industry investment in the park (amount undisclosed). Reinforces Suzhou as J&J Medical's largest integrated China campus.

business_events.title: China VBP (volume-based procurement) pressure on MedTech
business_events.summary: J&J flagged continued China headwinds from government volume-based procurement plus ~USD 500M tariff exposure in 2026 — driving a cost/efficiency focus that favors finance automation and shared-services optimization.

business_events.title: SAP-led 'Intelligent Finance Transformation' (S/4HANA consolidation)
business_events.summary: J&J is consolidating 20+ ERP and 20+ non-ERP systems onto SAP S/4HANA with a roadmap built jointly with SAP; Switzerland S/4HANA go-live ~2023. Major global finance re-platforming relevant to T&E and SSC tooling.

business_events.title: Kenvue consumer-health spin-off completed
business_events.summary: J&J separated its consumer arm as Kenvue (2023); remaining J&J focuses on Innovative Medicine (Pharma) + MedTech. Service-pact wind-down between J&J and Kenvue is ongoing (incl. Kenvue layoffs), implying SSC/IT disentanglement work.

ai_summary_cn: 强生（J&J，纽交所代码JNJ，2023年已剥离消费品业务Kenvue，现聚焦创新药Innovative Medicine与医疗科技MedTech，全球营收约888亿美元/约14万员工）在华规模庞大：约10,000–11,000名员工、约16家法人主体、覆盖90多个城市，中国总部位于上海徐汇，重点城市包括上海、北京、广州、苏州、西安（最早合资企业西安杨森，1985年进入中国）。核心切入点：强生在苏州工业园设有亚太/北亚财务共享服务中心（J&J Global Finance Services Suzhou，约170名财务人员，负责中国大陆、港台、日韩的AR/AP/总账），是全球5大GBS交付中心之一，覆盖财务、HR、采购三大职能，苏州同时是其医疗器械最大综合园区（含智能制造、研发与区域采购）。技术栈方面，强生全球以SAP为主ERP（ECC 6.0正向S/4HANA迁移，正与SAP联合推进整合20+ERP系统的“智能财务转型”），并已于2016年选用SAP Concur Expense替换旧报销系统——因此中国大概率已是Concur存量客户，机会点在于升级、扩容、迁移与优化而非全新部署。近期信号强烈：2026年1月MedTech转向更去中心化的业务单元运营模式、2025年苏州本地化生产高端超声刀并追加高端医疗器械投资、中国VBP集采与约5亿美元关税压力推动降本增效，且全球及苏州/亚太GBS持续招聘SAP财务、共享服务FP&A与采购等转型相关岗位。综合判断：这是一个以苏州财务共享中心为核心、SAP+Concur已落地、正处于S/4HANA转型与成本优化窗口期的高价值目标客户。
